old_28ms_benchmark.description: Static dense 900s warm transitions benchmark of the combined #365 arm, before #370 refusal integration

comparison_protocol: Same box, same compiler/optimization flags, same frozen trace/window; one excluded raw variants warmup and one excluded first transition followed by six warm requests per process; two reversed-order rounds; explicit PGWT_CURRENT_TRACE_CACHE_STATS=1; 5s time_model canaries only.
historical_paints: PRE gate-2 versus final VM 169962399; no ratios or server-time subtraction used for causal attribution.
prior_attempt: Sources and historical browser logs retained; prior timing sweeps did not set PGWT_CURRENT_TRACE_CACHE_STATS and are superseded by audit/.
excluded_probe: audit/edge-first/ started with aggregate edges before raw priming; explicit cache statistics exposed suffix-only retention and subsequent repeated raw decoding. Superseded by raw-primed audit/measure.jsonl; used for no reported performance claim.
browser_cache_observation: Every arm has the identical 33-report decoded-counter pattern: 1239 cached window blocks; only Waterfall detail planning-marker lookback decodes another 712 older blocks per cycle. No Matrix or other 900s window request decodes new blocks. Full paints include this actual product behaviour.
